description: A daylight detector on a stone base feeding a lamp: the lamp follows the light level.
verifyNote: the output follows the time of day, so the success check cannot be decided from the block state alone: the live round reads /observe.time and the lamp together
notes: Bedrock has a separate block id for the inverted detector (`daylight_detector_inverted`) that no item places, so this blueprint builds the normal one: the lamp lights during the day. Spec deviation, documented on purpose rather than papered over.
